fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so emergency equipment can reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Install a turnaround area or clearly mark a reversing zone near the detached structure so large emergency vehicles can exit without backing the full length of the drive.
• Trim dense vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles on both sides and overhead.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around both buildings without obstruction.
• Keep a gate or barrier at the single access point unlocked or equipped with a Knox-type lock box so responders are not delayed at entry.
• Mow or clear the open lawn area adjacent to the access drive so it can be used as a staging area for emergency equipment if the drive is blocked.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Clear tall grass within the immediate area surrounding the structure down to bare ground or short mowed height.
• Trim shrubs that are directly touching or within a few feet of the structure's walls and foundation.
• Thin scattered trees close to the structure so their branches do not touch or hang over the roof or walls.
• Remove woody debris piles visible near the structure.
• Cut back or remove mixed vegetation growing close to the structure on all sides.
• Separate shrub clusters from one another so they do not form a continuous band of plants leading toward the structure.
• Keep low ground vegetation mowed short in the open areas between trees and the structure.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from around the base of trees near the structure.
• Keep the single access driveway clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Maintain enough cleared space along the driveway so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Thin tree branches that extend over the driveway to allow full vehicle clearance.
• Remove any woody debris or fallen branches from along the driveway edges.
• Keep the area between scattered trees open by removing shrubs and tall grass growing underneath and between them near the structure.
